input: Analyze generation supply stack bids, forecasted regional load, and planned transmission outages driving day-ahead clearing prices.
expected_output:
### Executive Summary
**Day-Ahead Locational Marginal Prices (LMP) are projected to peak at \$114.20/MWh during Hour Ending (HE) 18 due to a combined 51.2 GW regional peak load and a critical 345 kV transmission outage on the West-to-East corridor. Generation supply stack bids indicate marginal gas peakers (Heat Rate $\ge 11,200\text{ Btu/kWh}$) will clear between HE 16 and HE 20, driving an estimated 38.4% congestion cost premium in eastern delivery nodes. The overall 24-hour forecast model maintains a backtested Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 3.82% within a 95% Confidence Interval.**

---

### Data Presentation: Market Drivers & LMP Metrics

| Metric | Current Value | Baseline / Target | Delta (%) | Status (Normal/Warning/Critical) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Peak Forecasted Load (HE 18)** | 51,200 MW | 44,500 MW | +15.06% | **Warning** |

The degradation is primarily driven by sharp unforecasted ramping events, transmission constraint shadow price spikes, and localized generator deratings during rapid ambient temperature shifts. As a result, price volatility expands the 95% Confidence Interval band by +184% relative to normal operating regimes, increasing unhedged spot market exposure.**

---

### 2. Data Presentation

The table below summarizes model accuracy and risk metrics comparing baseline operations against extreme weather transition periods across evaluated grid zones:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Normal Regime MAPE** | 3.82% | < 5.00% | -23.60% | **Normal** |
| **Mean Absolute Error (MAE)** | $14.20/MWh | $3.50/MWh | +305.71% | **Critical** |

| **Energy Component Forecast Error** | 6.10% | < 4.00% | +52.50% | **Warning** |

- **Incorporate Dynamic Line Ratings & Outage Telemetry**: Integrate real-time transmission constraint telemetry and generator ambient de-rate curves into the nodal shadow price predictor to mitigate the 22.4% congestion forecast error.
- **Automate Emergency Mode Overrides**: Trigger dynamic tolerance widening in the trading execution system during NERC/ISO weather alerts to prevent false-positive arbitrage signals.
